requests.title: nextId > is one past the max id
requests.reason: The test builds Todo objects with `done`. After the rename to `completed` that no longer type-checks, so I changed it to use `completed`. The test's logic and what it checks are the same.

requests.title: format > formats open and done todos
requests.reason: Todo.done is renamed to Todo.completed. The fixtures used `done`, which no longer type-checks, and at runtime the done todo would render as "[ ]". Only the fixture field name changed. The expected output strings are the same.

requests.title: storage > round-trips todos
requests.reason: The fixture used `done: false`, but Todo has renamed that field to `completed`. load now turns `done` into `completed`, so the old fixture would fail the round-trip check and would also fail type-checking. I changed the fixture to `completed: false`, which the instruction asks for. The test checks the same thing as before.

requests.title: commands > adds and completes
requests.reason: The test reads `t.done`, and that field is now renamed to `completed` on Todo. I changed it to read `t.completed`. The assertion is otherwise unchanged, and this is the fixture update the instruction asks for.
